name: nth like DNA glycosylase 1

function.text: NTHL1 encodes endonuclease III-like protein 1 lyase). Annotated molecular activities include endonuclease activity and DNA N-glycosylase activity. It participates in depyrimidination and nucleotide-excision repair.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to NTHL1-deficiency tumor predisposition syndrome (autosomal recessive); familial adenomatous polyposis 3 (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: NTHL1 encodes nth like DNA glycosylase 1. The DNA N-glycosylase activity releases the damaged DNA base from DNA by cleaving the N-glycosidic bond, leaving an AP site. The AP-lyase activity cleaves the phosphodiester bond 3' to the AP site by a beta-elimination. It also has 8-oxo-7,8-dihydroguanine (8-oxoG) DNA glycosylase activity.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with NTHL1-deficiency tumor predisposition syndrome (autosomal recessive); familial adenomatous polyposis 3 (autosomal recessive).
